ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1.6:1 ratio of high-intensity (white/cream) to low-intensity (black/grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large high-intensity contiguous blobs occupying central lobe regions; low-intensity peripheral borders; significant low-intensity mottling and focal spotting concentrated on the distal half of the right lobe and the area immediately surrounding the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated aperture of 48 degrees and high vertical bounding-box depth relative to fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude (2-4 pixel) serration pattern continuous along the trailing edges of both lobes, isolated against the lighter water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature sweep along the trailing edges, transitioning into an upward-tapered trajectory at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated low-intensity (black) pixel clusters on the mid-distal high-intensity (white) field of the right lobe; small high-intensity (white) punctate marks on the low-intensity (black) leading edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions oriented roughly perpendicular to the trailing edge on the white field of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Textured, brownish-grey clusters (indicative of colonization) at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; distinct irregular indentation/notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe approximately one-third of the distance from the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent accumulation of non-pigment-based textured masses at the extreme lobe terminals.
